company_news.headline: Dominion Energy Charitable Foundation Fall Grant Cycle Now Open

company_news.headline: Dominion Energy (D) Starts Requiring Bank Guarantees For AI Data Center Power Deals
company_news.summary: Dominion Energy (NYSE:D) is asking AI data center developers to provide bank letters of credit to secure large power commitments. The utility is using financial guarantees to screen speculative projects tied to rapid AI related power demand. The shift is intended to limit potential financial risk for Dominion Energy and its customer base as grid investment needs grow.
